name: Zest Rain
source:
Zest served [url=/c167771]Sheila[/url], and later the demon who imprisoned her. Together with [url=/c153144]Lars[/url] and the others, [url=/c144566]I[/url] easily destroyed the demon and his castle. During the battle, Zest was confused, and I noticed it. That's why I decided not to kill her. She was impressed by my decision, and under the influence of my aura, she began to desire me.
